Instructor solution. The grader runs this file once and uses it to confirm the
rubric's object names. Do not hand this file out. See `docs/conventions.md`.

```{r load-data}
library(ggplot2)
artifacts <- read.csv("artifacts.csv")
```

## Task 1: Length against width, by raw material

```{r scatter-plot}
length_width_plot <- ggplot(artifacts, aes(x = length_mm, y = width_mm, colour = raw_material)) +
  geom_point() +
  labs(
    x = "Length (mm)",
    y = "Width (mm)",
    colour = "Raw material",
    title = "Artifact length against width"
  )
```
